about.title: About & data
about.intro: Worldwise is a small geography game built around relationships between places: direction, order, distance, and borders.
about.worldBody: The World collection uses Natural Earth 1:50m cultural vectors for country boundaries and capital coordinates. It includes 193 sovereign countries plus Vatican City when a source capital point is available.
about.europeBody: The Europe collection is a derived Practice collection made from the same normalized country records. It contains 45 countries selected for this first regional set.
about.borderBody: Land-border routes are computed from the same 1:50m country geometry. Disputed territories, enclaves, and maritime-only borders are excluded by default so routes stay clear and reproducible.
about.privacyBody: There is no account, analytics, or server sync. Your progress and preferences stay in this browser. Use Settings to export a backup or remove local data.
about.sourceNote: Worldwise uses and transforms Natural Earth 1:50m data for country geometry and capital coordinates. Border routes are derived by Worldwise from that geometry. Made with Natural Earth.

home.heroTitle: How well does your mental map match the real world?
home.heroBody: Start with today's Compass. See where the shortest route really points, then explore two more ways to think geographically.

compass.mapLabel: Map comparing the shortest route on the globe with the straight line on a flat map, and your arrow.
compass.legendFlat: Straight line on a flat map
compass.flatMapNoteSameDirection: On a flat map, the straight line to {destination} points at {flatDegrees}°. But the Earth is round: the shortest route bends {side}, so it actually leaves {origin} at {degrees}°.

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Worldwise is a short daily geography ritual about relationships between places—not a memory quiz.
howToPlay.dailyBody: Every UTC day has one shared challenge in each mode. Complete the three required medium challenges to finish the ritual and advance your streak.
howToPlay.requiredTier: Medium is the required tier and is designed to take a few minutes.
howToPlay.bonusTiers: Easy and Hard are optional bonus challenges. They never affect your streak.
howToPlay.compassBody: Point the arrow toward the destination. After submitting, compare your answer with the shortest route, then see how a flat map can bend your sense of direction.
howToPlay.arrangeBody: Put places in the correct geographic order. Use the up and down controls—dragging is never required.
howToPlay.borderRunBody: Build a land-border route to the destination within the hop budget. A shortest route earns full credit; valid detours earn less.
howToPlay.scoringBody: Scores reward correct direction, efficient routes, and well-ordered places. Border Run gives full credit for a shortest route and partial credit for valid detours. Time never changes your score.
howToPlay.practiceBody: Choose World or Europe, a mode, and a difficulty for unlimited fresh challenges. Practice progress is separate from your daily streak.
howToPlay.privacyTitle: Your progress stays on this device
howToPlay.privacyBody: Worldwise has no account or leaderboard. Daily progress, streaks, and statistics are stored locally in your browser.
